verses.transcription: madahtun nabiyyal muntaqan nuura azmaanaa

verses.text: لِوَجْهِ رَحِيمٍ لَّمْ يَزَلْ قَطُّ رَحْمَانَا
verses.transcription: liwajhi rahiimin lam yazal qattu rahmaanaa
hamaanii hanish shaytaani wad durri maalikii

verses.text: بِجَاهِ شَفِيعٍ قَادَ لِى مِنْهُ إِحْسَانَا
verses.transcription: bijaahi shafiihin qaada lii minhu ihsaanaa

verses.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْبَاقِى وَعَنْ خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ
verses.transcription: radiitu hanil baaqii wa han khayri khalqihi
wa fii madhihi jaawaztu kahban wa hassanaa
rafahtu ilal mukhtaari lil laahi muddatan
midaadii wa aqlaamii wa lii zaana miizaanaa
mahal laahu amraadan nahatnii bijaahihi

verses.text: كَمَا لِسِوَى قَلْبِى نَفَى اللَّهُ أَحْزَانَا
verses.transcription: kamaa lisiwaa qalbii nafal laahu ahzaanaa
muhammadunal mukhtaaru maahin wa mukrimun
halayhi salaatul laahi maadaama mihwaanaa

verses.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى مَدْحِى النَّبِى حُبُّ ذَاتِهِ
verses.transcription: dahaanii ilaa madhin nabii hubbu zaatihi

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ سَلَامُ اللَّهِ مَا حُزْتُ رِضْوَانَا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaamul laahi maa huztu ridwaanaa
hamaanii ilaahii bin nabii han madarratin
wa lii tayyabal mukhtaaru bil laahi awtaanaa
izaa qudttu lil mukhtaari bil laahi khidmatan
kafaanii bihil baaqii shaqaa-an wa shaytaanaa

verses.text: حَمِدْتُّ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ رَبِّى الَّذِى مَحَا
verses.transcription: hamidttu halal mukhtaari rabbil lazii mahaa

verses.text: عُيُوبًا نَّحَتْ ذَاتِى وَلِى قَادَ غُفْرَانَا
verses.transcription: huyuuban nahat zaatii wa lii qaada ghufraanaa

verses.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ قَصْدَ الضُّرِّ نَحْوِى بِجَاهِ مَنْ
verses.transcription: mahal laahu qasdad durri nahwii bijaahi man

verses.text: إِلَيْهِ بِهِ أَوْصَلْتُ مَا فَاقَ جِيرَانَا
verses.transcription: ilayhi bihi aw saltu maa faaqa jiiraanaa
dahaanii li-ikhdaamin nabii hubbu zaatihi

verses.text: بِحُبِّى رَحِيمًا لَّمْ يَزَلْ قَطُّ رَحْمَانَا
verses.transcription: bihubbii rahiiman lam yazal qattu rahmaanaa

bayts.text: مَدَحْتُ النَّبِىَّ الْمُنْتَقَى النُّورَ أَزْمَانَا ۞ لِوَجْهِ رَحِيمٍ لَّمْ يَزَلْ قَطُّ رَحْمَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho lodato il Profeta, il Prescelto, la Luce, per lunghi tempi, per il Volto di un Misericordioso (Ar-Raḥīm) che non ha mai cessato di essere Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān).
translations.en.karamati: I have praised the Prophet, the Select One, the Light, for long ages, for the Face of a Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) Who has never ceased to be All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān).
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai loué le Prophète, le Préféré, la Lumière, durant de longs temps, pour la Face d'un Très-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥīm) qui n'a jamais cessé d'être Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān).

bayts.text: حَمَانِى عَنِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَالضُّرِّ مَالِكِى ۞ بِجَاهِ شَفِيعٍ قَادَ لِى مِنْهُ إِحْسَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha protetto da Satana e dal danno il mio Padrone, per il rango di un intercessore che mi ha condotto da parte Sua il bene.
translations.en.karamati: My Master protected me from Satan and harm, by the rank of an intercessor who led goodness to me from Him.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a protégé de Satan et du mal mon Maître, par le rang d'un intercesseur qui m'a amené de Sa part le bien.

bayts.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْبَاقِى وَعَنْ خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ ۞ وَفِى مَدْحِهِ جَاوَزْتُ كَعْبًا وَحَسَّنَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono compiaciuto del Permanente (Al-Bāqī) e del migliore delle Sue creature, e nella lode di lui ho superato Kaʿb (ibn Zuhayr) e Ḥassān (ibn Thābit).
translations.en.karamati: I am well pleased with the Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) and with the best of His creation, and in praising him I have surpassed Kaʿb (ibn Zuhayr) and Ḥassān (ibn Thābit).
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis satisfait du Permanent (Al-Bāqī) et du meilleur de Ses créatures, et dans sa louange j'ai dépassé Kaʿb (ibn Zuhayr) et Ḥassān (ibn Thābit).

bayts.text: رَفَعْتُ إِلَى الْمُخْتَارِ لِلَّهِ مُدَّةً ۞ مِّدَادِى وَأَقْلَامِى وَلِى زَانَ مِيزَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho innalzato all'Eletto, per Allah, per un tempo, il mio inchiostro e le mie penne, ed egli mi ha adornato la bilancia.
translations.en.karamati: I raised to the Chosen One, for Allah, for a span, my ink and my pens, and he adorned my scale.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai élevé vers l'Élu, pour Allah, pendant un temps, mon encre et mes plumes, et il m'a orné la balance.

bayts.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ أَمْرَاضًا نَّحَتْنِى بِجَاهِهِ ۞ كَمَا لِسِوَى قَلْبِى نَفَى اللَّهُ أَحْزَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Allah ha cancellato, per il suo rango, malattie che si dirigevano verso di me, così come Allah ha respinto le tristezze verso altro che il mio cuore.
translations.en.karamati: Allah erased, by his rank, illnesses heading toward me, just as Allah repelled sorrows toward other than my heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Allah a effacé, par son rang, des maladies qui se dirigeaient vers moi, de même qu'Allah a repoussé les tristesses vers autre chose que mon cœur.

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ مَاحٍ وَمُكْرِمٌ ۞ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ مَادَامَ مِعْوَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Eletto, è Colui che cancella e che onora: su di lui la benedizione di Allah, finché Egli resta Soccorritore.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, the Chosen One, is the Effacer and the Honourer: upon him the blessing of Allah, as long as He remains the Helper.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Élu, est celui qui efface et qui honore : sur lui la bénédiction d'Allah, tant qu'Il demeure Secourable.

bayts.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى مَدْحِى النَّبِى حُبُّ ذَاتِهِ ۞ عَلَيْهِ سَلَامُ اللَّهِ مَا حُزْتُ رِضْوَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha chiamato a lodare il Profeta l'amore per la sua persona: su di lui la pace di Allah, finché ottengo il compiacimento.
translations.en.karamati: The love of his person has called me to praise the Prophet: upon him the peace of Allah, as long as I win good pleasure.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a appelé à louer le Prophète l'amour de sa personne : sur lui la paix d'Allah, tant que j'obtiens l'agrément.

bayts.text: حَمَانِى إِلَاهِى بِالنَّبِى عَنْ مَّضَرَّةٍ ۞ وَلِى طَيَّبَ الْمُخْتَارُ بِاللَّهِ أَوْطَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Dio mi ha protetto, per mezzo del Profeta, da ogni danno, e l'Eletto, per Allah, mi ha reso buone le terre.
translations.en.karamati: My God protected me, through the Prophet, from harm, and the Chosen One, by Allah, made the lands good for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu m'a protégé, par le Prophète, de tout mal, et l'Élu, par Allah, m'a rendu bonnes les contrées.

bayts.text: إِذَا قُدْتُّ لِلْمُخْتَارِ بِاللَّهِ خِدْمَةً ۞ كَفَانِى بِهِ الْبَاقِى شِقَآءً وَشَيْطَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Quando conduco all'Eletto, per Allah, un servizio, il Permanente per mezzo di esso mi preserva dalla miseria e da Satana.
translations.en.karamati: When I lead a service to the Chosen One, for Allah, the Everlasting through it spares me wretchedness and Satan.
translations.fr.karamati: Quand je conduis vers l'Élu, pour Allah, un service, le Permanent par lui me préserve de la misère et de Satan.

bayts.text: حَمِدْتُّ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ رَبِّى الَّذِى مَحَا ۞ عُيُوبًا نَّحَتْ ذَاتِى وَلِى قَادَ غُفْرَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho lodato, per l'Eletto, il mio Signore che ha cancellato difetti che si dirigevano verso la mia persona, e mi ha condotto il perdono.
translations.en.karamati: I have praised, for the Chosen One, my Lord Who erased faults heading toward my person, and led forgiveness to me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai loué, pour l'Élu, mon Seigneur qui a effacé des défauts qui se dirigeaient vers ma personne, et m'a amené le pardon.

bayts.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ قَصْدَ الضُّرِّ نَحْوِى بِجَاهِ مَنْ ۞ إِلَيْهِ بِهِ أَوْصَلْتُ مَا فَاقَ جِيرَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Allah ha cancellato l'intento del danno verso di me, per il rango di colui al quale, per mezzo di Lui, ho fatto giungere ciò che ha superato i (suoi) vicini.
translations.en.karamati: Allah erased the intent of harm toward me, by the rank of him to whom, through Him, I conveyed what surpassed the neighbours.
translations.fr.karamati: Allah a effacé le dessein du mal vers moi, par le rang de celui à qui, par Lui, j'ai fait parvenir ce qui a surpassé les (siens) voisins.

bayts.text: دَعَانِى لِإِخْدَامِ النَّبِى حُبُّ ذَاتِهِ ۞ بِحُبِّى رَحِيمًا لَّمْ يَزَلْ قَطُّ رَحْمَانَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha chiamato al servizio del Profeta l'amore per la sua persona, insieme al mio amore per un Misericordioso che non ha mai cessato di essere Compassionevole.
translations.en.karamati: The love of his person has called me to the Prophet's service, with my love for a Most Merciful Who has never ceased to be All-Merciful.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a appelé au service du Prophète l'amour de sa personne, avec mon amour pour un Très-Miséricordieux qui n'a jamais cessé d'être Tout-Miséricordieux.
